responsibilities: Handle user input mapping from raw screen touches/mouse clicks into usable internal game state.
constraints: Must absolutely not use Flutter's GestureDetector, Listener, or any other widget.
Must avoid creating 'InputEvent' objects per frame. Store pointer states in fixed size Float32List (for x/y) and Uint8List (for up/down state) or similar flat memory.
Maintain zero allocations per frame for input polling.
